It also records signs of a return to routine, including businesses resuming operations and plans for a public meeting honoring the armed forces. The material reflects the early consolidation of the new military government and its framing of opponents as security threats, amid efforts to suppress possible resistance. The folder’s short date range concerns immediate post-coup unrest and countermeasures, rather than a sustained military campaign.
